title: Audit existing OpenClaw before controlled upgrade
description: Read-only health and upgrade audit of the existing OpenClaw installation. Back up the local OpenClaw state directory, then inspect installed/latest versions, update status, Gateway status, scheduled task presence, listener on port 18789, configuration file inventory and doctor command capabilities. Potential secrets are redacted before output. No OpenClaw update, repair, onboarding, Gateway install/start/stop or configuration change is performed.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $BackupRoot=Join-Path 'C:\3EN-Agent\backups\018b' $stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BackupRoot | Out-Null; Set-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-018b-current.txt' -Value $BackupRoot -Encoding UTF8; $state=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $state){$dest=Join-Path $BackupRoot 'openclaw-state'; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $state -Destination $dest -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('OPENCLAW_STATE_BACKUP='+$dest)}else{Write-Host 'OPENCLAW_STATE_BACKUP=NO_STATE_DIR'}; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$BackupRoot); Write-Host 'BACKUP_018B_READY'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:\3EN-Agent'; $report=Join-Path $root 'openclaw-audit-018b.txt'; $out=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; function A([string]$s){$out.Add($s); Write-Host $s}; function Safe([string]$s){if($null -eq $s){return ''}; $x=$s; $x=[regex]::Replace($x,'(?i)(token|api[_-]?key|authorization|bearer|password|secret)(\s*[=:]\s*)[^,\s"}]+','$1$2[REDACTED]'); $x=[regex]::Replace($x,'(?i)("(?:token|api[_-]?key|authorization|password|secret)"\s*:\s*")[^"]+(")','$1[REDACTED]$2'); return $x}; function RunSafe([string]$label,[scriptblock]$cmd){A ('--- '+$label+' ---'); try{$r=(& $cmd 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 500).Trim(); if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($r)){A 'NO_OUTPUT'}else{foreach($line in @($r -split '\r?\n')){A (Safe ([string]$line))}}}catch{A ('ERROR='+$_.Exception.Message)}}; A '=== OPENCLAW EXISTING INSTALL AUDIT 018B ==='; A ('TIMESTAMP='+([DateTime]::Now.ToString('o'))); $oc=Get-Command openclaw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if(-not $oc){throw 'OpenClaw command not found although 018a detected it'}; A ('OPENCLAW_PATH='+$oc.Source); RunSafe 'INSTALLED VERSION' {openclaw --version}; RunSafe 'NPM LATEST VERSION' {npm view openclaw version --json}; RunSafe 'OPENCLAW UPDATE STATUS' {openclaw update status --json}; RunSafe 'GATEWAY STATUS JSON' {openclaw gateway status --json}; A ''; A '=== PORT 18789 ==='; $ls=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 18789 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if($ls.Count -gt 0){$pids=@($ls | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique); A ('PORT_18789_LISTENING=TRUE PID='+($pids -join ',')); foreach($pidv in $pids){$p=Get-Process -Id $pidv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;if($p){A ('PORT_18789_PROCESS='+$p.ProcessName+' PID='+$pidv)}}}else{A 'PORT_18789_LISTENING=FALSE'}; A ''; A '=== OPENCLAW SCHEDULED TASK ==='; $tasks=@(Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.TaskName -match '(?i)openclaw'}); if($tasks.Count -eq 0){A 'OPENCLAW_SCHEDULED_TASK_COUNT=0'}else{A ('OPENCLAW_SCHEDULED_TASK_COUNT='+$tasks.Count); foreach($t in $tasks){$info=$null;try{$info=Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $t.TaskName -TaskPath $t.TaskPath -ErrorAction Stop}catch{}; A ('TASK='+$t.TaskName+' STATE='+$t.State+$(if($info){' LAST_RESULT='+$info.LastTaskResult+' LAST_RUN='+$info.LastRunTime.ToString('o')}else{''}))}}; A ''; A '=== STATE INVENTORY (NO CONTENT) ==='; $state=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $state){$files=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $state -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); A ('STATE_FILE_COUNT='+$files.Count); foreach($f in @($files | Where-Object {$_.Extension -in '.json','.json5','.yaml','.yml','.toml','.cmd','.ps1'} | Sort-Object FullName | Select-Object -First 80)){A ('STATE_FILE='+$f.FullName+' SIZE='+$f.Length+' SHA256='+(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)}}else{A 'STATE_DIR_MISSING=TRUE'}; A ''; RunSafe 'DOCTOR HELP ONLY' {openclaw doctor --help}; A ''; A '=== AUDIT DECISION ==='; $installed=((& openclaw --version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()); $latest=((& npm view openclaw version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()); A ('INSTALLED_RAW='+$installed); A ('LATEST_RAW='+$latest); if($installed -match [regex]::Escape($latest)){A 'UPGRADE_REQUIRED=FALSE'}else{A 'UPGRADE_REQUIRED=TRUE'}; A 'OPENCLAW_AUDIT_018B=PASS'; $out | Set-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host ('REPORT='+$report)
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $report='C:\3EN-Agent\openclaw-audit-018b.txt'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $report)){throw 'OpenClaw audit report missing'}; $c=Get-Content -LiteralPath $report -Raw; foreach($m in @('OPENCLAW EXISTING INSTALL AUDIT 018B','INSTALLED VERSION','NPM LATEST VERSION','GATEWAY STATUS JSON','STATE INVENTORY','AUDIT DECISION','OPENCLAW_AUDIT_018B=PASS')){if($c -notmatch [regex]::Escape($m)){throw ('Missing marker: '+$m)}}; if($c -match '(?i)(token|api[_-]?key|authorization|bearer|password|secret)\s*[=:]\s*(?!\[REDACTED\])\S+'){Write-Warning 'Potential credential-like text detected in report; inspect before sharing.'}; Write-Host ('REPORT_SIZE='+(Get-Item -LiteralPath $report).Length); Write-Host 'VALIDATION_018B=PASS'
rollback: Write-Host 'READ-ONLY AUDIT: OpenClaw state was backed up but not modified; no rollback required.'
